info.title: CardVault enrollment-service
info.description: Wallet enrolment system of record for CardVault Bank: card eligibility, enrolment with the wallet operator (pushed through the outbox, confirmed by signed callbacks), reactions to card and contact changes, and the customer's wallet choices (opt-out, opt-in, add and remove a card).

get.description: 200 when the service's database (and Kafka, if it uses Kafka) answer.
Every card of the customer with its wallet eligibility (and the first failing reason) and its enrolment status.

get.summary: View one card in my wallet
get.description: Eligibility and enrolment status of one card (useful for polling PENDING).

post.summary: Add a card to my wallet
post.description: Starts enrolment (202, status PENDING). A card already ENROLLED, PENDING or SUSPENDED returns 200 with its current state. An opted-out customer gets 409 WALLET_OPTED_OUT; an ineligible card gets 422 CARD_INELIGIBLE with the reason in details.reason. Clears an earlier removal of this card. Accepts `Idempotency-Key`: the same key returns the same response.

delete.summary: Remove a card from my wallet
delete.description: The enrolment becomes REMOVED at once and the wallet operator is told. The eligibility sweep never re-adds this card; adding it again or opting in clears that. Repeating it returns 200 with the current state. Accepts `Idempotency-Key`: the same key returns the same response.

post.description: Removes every card from the wallet at once (status REMOVED) and tells the wallet operator. Repeating it returns 200 with the current wallet. Accepts `Idempotency-Key`: the same key returns the same response.

Accepts the given terms version, clears the opt-out and any per-card removals, and enrols every eligible card (each becomes PENDING, then ENROLLED when the wallet operator confirms). Accepts `Idempotency-Key`: the same key returns the same response.

HMAC-SHA256 over `{X-Timestamp}.{raw body}`, lowercase hex in X-Signature; X-Timestamp is Unix seconds within 5 minutes of the bank's clock. Deduplicated by event_id. A lower operator_version than the stored one is ignored as stale.

Fetches the operator's enrolment file for `file_date` and compares it with the SOR. 201 with the run and its findings. If the file cannot be fetched the run is stored as FAILED and 502 OPERATOR_FILE_UNAVAILABLE is returned with its run_id. Tests key only.

get.summary: Get a reconciliation run and its findings

post.description: Truncates this service's tables, clears faults, idempotency keys and lockouts, and skips consumers to the end of their topics.
Resets this service, then writes the deterministic seed data.

post.summary: Create a fresh customer with cards (test orchestrator)
post.description: Creates the login (auth), profile (profile-service), cards (card-service) and, for cards with enrolled=true, a token at the network, a record at the wallet operator, an ENROLLED enrolment here and the token in card-service. Returns the credentials, customer_id, every card_id and every token_ref.

post.summary: Run the daily eligibility sweep now
post.description: Checks every card: enrols cards that became eligible (FAILED ones at most once a day), removes enrolments that became ineligible, suspends or resumes as the card status requires. TEST_MODE only; needs the tests X-Service-Key.
